stop_loss_observations: SLO-TTA-BA-1 (BLOCKING, evidence fabrication): 12 of 326 ledger claims carry citation envelopes that do not resolve. Nine are fabricated (MD-HIST-001/002 use the SHA-256 of the empty byte string as blob_sha256 and share one identical range hash across two different ranges -- the real historical blob at 097545f1 is a05dc35f...; WVZ-COMP-004, WVZ-MECH-019, WVZ-TEST-007 match no contiguous window of the cited file or its host copies at any width/encoding; WVZ-TEST-008, WVZ-HIST-002/003/004 are literally sequential-hex placeholder strings). Three are anchor-drifted (WVZ-COMP-005 real window 484-504 vs cited 482-504; WVZ-COMP-006 real 33 vs cited 35; WVZ-MECH-008 real 172-182 vs cited 171-182). Per the program rule 'One unsupported or fabricated factual claim stops the batch', gates G-CL and G-SL are RED and Batch A acceptance is blocked until the magic-defense and wizard-vs-zombie evidence is remediated (re-collection or receipt-superseding correction). 10 of the 12 bad ids are cited as blueprint backing (MD-HIST-001/002; WVZ-COMP-004/005/006, WVZ-HIST-004, WVZ-MECH-008/019, WVZ-TEST-007/008), so the blueprint is evidentially contaminated in those entries even though its structural references resolve.

SLO-TTA-BA-2 (BLOCKING, receipt immutability breach, A15-class): the wizard-vs-zombie evidence-collector receipt was mutated in place by commit ca423fbb (an unrelated Company SSO track commit), rewriting its commit_sha and final-response fields after binding; its enumerated output hash for the wizard-vs-zombie final report matches neither the HEAD bytes nor the bytes at the authoritative bind commit 20af6417. This is the full IMP-WVZ-1 manifestation; G-RR stays red until a superseding receipt lands on a new commit. The original must not be edited again.

SLO-TTA-BA-3 (informational, line-anchor drift): several hash-honest magic-defense claims carry drifted prose line anchors (MD-MECH-002 cites controller line 48 while the XP formula lives at lines 45-46; MD-MECH-003 names useGameStore.ts line 9 while MAX_CASTLE_HP is exported at line 13; MD-MECH-008 cites GameEngine.tsx 337-340 while the lowercased translation equality lives at line 369; MD-TRANS-002's status assignment sits one line past the cited range). Hashes match the cited ranges; semantics re-derive from the pinned blobs. Recorded for the adversarial reviewer's sampling pass.

SLO-TTA-BA-4 (confirmed, confined): IMP-CD-1 (castle-defense receipt lacks the final-response hash field entirely) and IMP-MD-1 (magic-defense receipt carries the strategy-documented placeholder literal) are exactly the two documented A15-class receipt imperfections and no others exist in the receipt set; the suite confines this state so any new placeholder fails loudly. G-RR remediation (superseding receipts on new commits) remains outstanding.
